SELECT name, listprice, 'LeastExpensive' AS LeastExpensive
FROM (
    SELECT name, listprice, 
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY listprice ASC) AS rn,
           MIN(listprice) OVER (PARTITION BY productsubcategoryid) AS min_price
    FROM production.product
    WHERE productsubcategoryid = 37
) ranked
WHERE listprice = min_price
ORDER BY listprice;
